artifact_caps.requires_context_preflight: A future role adapter must independently verify serialized prompt plus cap fits its pinned model context; existing8192-context author worker cannot be reused unchanged.

plan.authoring: Twelve canonical raw author records plus one collective judgment; 48 four-domain paired author records plus 48 independent semantic/narrative-fact judgments.
plan.boilerplate: The entire numeric-table or narrative-stakes representation is the designated telemetry payload; no other shared prompt field differs between consequence versions.
plan.cell_counts: Four scenarios per domain per cell; every structure spans four cells and all three costs.
plan.evaluation_scope: One assigned cell per scenario, crossed with 2 arms × 2 formats × 2 modes; no additional 12-fold expansion.
plan.execution_partition: Two 96-episode chunks per arm × format × cot: 16 fixed chunks, each covering six canonical structures and all four domains; five fresh pilots each.
plan.paired_source_control: Both consequence versions authored together but only the preassigned version evaluated. Alternate version used only for exact masked-boilerplate/history checks.
plan.payoff_control: Author numeric objects must equal registered typed facts; independent narrative fact extraction and semantic judgment must match them in every domain and both consequences.
plan.pre_action_group: canonical_structure_id; retain matched_domain_group_id and scenario_id for finer paired joins
plan.pre_action_timing: Layer48 token immediately before generation-side <think>; never use generated text.

resource_bound.admission: Prospective ceiling only; root must freeze actual wrapper/resource profile and full reservation before launch.

plan.tool_order: All six declaration orders occur eight times per domain and are identical across arms, formats and modes for each scenario.
